profile.headline: Software Engineer, Full-Stack
profile.summary:
Highly motivated and accountable full-stack software engineer with extensive expertise in creating
high-quality mission-critical Single-Page Applications using modern JS frameworks to deliver high-value SaaS products and features. Full stack developer with experience contributing to the front
and back ends of microservice-driven web applications. Fluent with Java, JavaScript, TypeScript,
React, HTML, and CSS. Excellent at collaborating and communicating effectively with product
management, design, stakeholders, and other engineers. Experienced with all stages of software
development, from design to testing to production. Independent thinker with great ability to solve
complex problems and learn new technologies. Effectively demonstrates agile methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Cary, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
(Actalent Services LLC contractor) Full-Stack, DoD SaaS project
● Wrote web components and applications using React, Material UI, Micro UIs, and Storybook.
Tests written with Jest/React Testing Library. Wrote Java RESTful APIs and service classes to
execute business logic. Tests written in JUnit/Mockito. Test coverage was 80% or more with QA
from SonarQube. Debugged microservices deployed with Helm/Kubernetes using kubectl.
● Collaborated with User Experience (UX) engineers to turn wireframes from Figma into responsive,
accessible, and intuitive user interfaces
● Quickly learned React Testing Library, became a Subject Matter Expert (SME), and discovered
the value of using it to write integration/functional tests for the UI to greatly increase confidence
● High sprint velocity, oftentimes finishing my work mid-sprint and helping others finish their work
and working ahead to continuously deliver value
● Created light-weight, reusable, customizable, and extensible alternative to heavy-weight Material
UI (MUI) table, significantly decreasing load times on complex forms by 66%
● Invented and implemented reusable and centralized editor configuration to enforce standards
using git submodules across several Micro UI repositories
● Mentored other team members

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.locationName: Cary, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
(Hansen Talent Group contractor) Full-Stack, Healthcare SaaS projects
● Worked on Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) driven web applications. Writing web
components and applications using React, TypeScript, NextJS, React Router, and NextJS. Tests
written with Jest. Writing Java RESTful APIs and service classes to execute business logic.
Tests written in JUnit and Mockito. Exposure to Camunda and Business Rules Management
System (BRMS) with Drools. Worked with NodeJS backends using Express. Worked with
Structured Query Language (SQL) and Oracle SQL Developer.
● Quickly delivered key features under tight deadlines. Immediately assigned to complete several
key features using React and TypeScript by myself where I successfully met a strict deadline
● Quickly learned NextJS and optimized load times of app from 4 seconds to 1 second
● Identified developer productivity bottlenecks and took initiative by writing up white papers
proposing appropriate solutions to help increase team throughput
● Mentored other team members

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Morgantown, West Virginia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Full-Stack, Mobile Development, Healthcare SaaS projects
● Worked on many different projects. Contributed several web application features using AngularJS
1.x and Java. Worked with Redux, React Native, and mobile development using Android Studio.
● Spearheaded the design of a Mongo read converter to fix mission-critical issues caused by

● Took initiative and operated as Team Lead during periods of senior absence

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Full-Stack, Team Lead, live DoD & Healthcare SaaS projects
● Worked on many web applications using Polymer, React, TypeScript, Redux, Material UI and
Java. Managed several reusable, customizable, extensible, and documented web component
libraries. Tests written with Jest, Mocha, Chai, and Sinon. Wrote Java RESTful APIs tested by
Junit and Mockito. Deployed applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Debugged services and
databases in cloud environments with AWS Console, Cloudwatch, EC2, and MongoDB Compass
● Became Subject Matter Expert (SME) with Polymer, cross-browser functionality, debugging
complex Internet Explorer bugs. People in the office would come to me specifically
● Significantly improved performance of BPMN graphing web application from 10 FPS to 45 FPS by
substituting SVGs for complex and heavy HTML web components
● Removed microservice dependency from many data-serving microservices by removing a call to
request Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) information for each request and instead placed the
information in a JWT upon authentication for microservices to read from upon request
● Part of a 3 dev team to investigate modern JavaScript frameworks to migrate to, I was assigned
React which ended up being selected, assisted incremental migration from Polymer to React
● Mentored many junior team members
● Led a couple of small (5-12) cross-functional teams as a dev lead, ran scrum ceremonies,
frequently collaborated with Business Analysts (BA), Project Managers (PM), and Project Owners
(PO) to capture requirements and write user stories with acceptance criteria
● Debugged microservices and mongo databases deployed to AWS
